name: EditorialAuth

props.description: Heading level of the story title. Pass 2 when the form card owns the page h1 (`<EditorialAuthCard level>`).
props.name: level

props.description: Decorative art (aria-hidden): the picture on the front card under artFrame="cards", rendered as given under artFrame="none".
props.name: art

props.description: "cards" wraps `art` in the fixed rotated card pair; "none" renders free-form art (floating app chips, an illustration) in an unframed auto-height box (--editorial-auth-art-free-max-width / --editorial-auth-art-free-height).
props.name: artFrame

props.description: "brand" paints the story column with the brand surface — --editorial-auth-brand-background (default hsl(var(--brand)); a deep gradient is a valid value) — and re-scopes --foreground / --muted-foreground / --text-brand inside it so the title, copy, kicker and benefit tick take the on-brand ink (--editorial-auth-brand-foreground, an HSL triple, default var(--brand-foreground); --editorial-auth-brand-muted-foreground defaults to it). Padded and rounded by --editorial-auth-brand-padding / --editorial-auth-brand-radius. Keep the pair at WCAG AA when you retint it.
props.name: appearance

related: CenteredShell — use variant="auth" for the application sign-in shell.
tagline: A sign-in / sign-up page (gh#1439): a story column (kicker, display title — line breaks kept —, copy, a decorative card pair carrying `art`, benefit lines with a check) beside the form card (`children`, default 460px). Geometry: `--editorial-auth-*`.
usage: DO keep the form in an EditorialAuthCard with Form + FormField.

Below 48rem the columns stack and the story becomes a compact band (kicker + one-line title, copy kept; art and benefits hidden). It is the kit's default as tokens (--editorial-auth-track-size, --editorial-auth-title-white-space, --editorial-auth-art-display, --editorial-auth-benefits-display …); re-declare them under your own query to keep the art.
